title: 高窄源杯 + 标准接水杯，近距离无遮挡
task_difference: 抓取高度、空杯重心和搬运/对准净空随源杯变高变窄而变化；接水杯、布局和控制原语保持 C1L1 名义配置。

geometry_notes.mass_model: Scale empty-cup ceramic volume against C1 0.165 kg using outer minus inner frustum.
geometry_notes.align_clearance_reason: At 0 deg the cup origin is lip_z - source_height. C1 used 0.15 m extra lip height; a 0.16 m cup would put the bottom below the receiver rim unless align clearance rises to 0.20 m.
geometry_notes.ready_offset_reason: trial01 used a 0.27 m vertical ready pose and recorded 76 N right_shoulder_yaw/torso contact. trial02 offset the ready TCP 100 mm back and the wrist went through the torso. The C1 ready TCP (source+[0,0,0.23]) is reused; it sits 70 mm above the taller rim.
